loaderCompatibility: packages/openclinxr/xr-asset-loading/src/generated-loaders.ts:82 registers MeshoptDecoder on the humanoid GLTFLoader; no KTX2 or Draco loader is registered. The ladder emits plain (uncompressed) GLBs with extensionsUsed [] — no KHR_texture_basisu, KHR_draco_mesh_compression or WebP — so every rung output is loadable as shipped.
